title: A profile of Amazon CEO Andy Jassy, who is killing projects, cutting staff, and pleasing Wall Street, while steering the company toward an AI-focused era (Bloomberg)
commentary: Jassy is running the oldest play in Big Tech — cut everything that isn't the core bet, tell Wall Street it's discipline, call it an AI pivot. The question is whether Amazon's AI infrastructure lead is durable or just a head start that OpenAI and Google are already erasing.
